name: Commerce Speedy
description: Adds the Speedy courier (Bulgaria) as a Drupal Commerce shipping method: live rate calculation for delivery to address, office, or automat/box via Speedy's REST API, an office/site pickup picker (with optional Google Maps), automatic shipment creation on order placement, and Print label (waybill) PDF generation. On-disk release 1.0.0-beta4 (core ^11).
project_description:
Module integrates Bulgarian provider Speedy with Drupal Commerce.

 Features 
 
 calculate shippings cost on order checkout for delivery to address, delivery to office, delivery to box (automat) 
 validate customer address on order checkout, in users Address book, in Store address. 
 generate shipment in Speedy when order is "place" 
 allow store administrator to set to send order from address, office or box (in store config) 
 generate "Print label" (waybill) in pdf file on Finalize shipment 
 
 If you have gmap key set-up in shipping method, the Pick-up office/box selection form will show a map with offices/box to select directly from the map.

 Post-Installation 
 Register account in Speedy ( https://myspeedy.speedy.bg/signup ), get API credentials.

Create and configure a shipping method.

 Known problems 
 Please use the issue queue to file any issues you encounter.
